description: The Space Mission Design Game provides an exciting way to learn about space exploration. It combines science, technology, creativity, and fun. It helps students understand how real space missions are planned and conducted.
summary: Project details wireless charging of vehicle
details: Wireless charging of electric vehicles is a modern technology used to charge the batteries of electric vehicles without connecting a physical charging cable. It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction. Electrical energy is transferred from a transmitter coil to a receiver coil through a magnetic field. This technology makes EV charging easier, safer and more convenient.
